description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.

title.zh: 修改HTTPDNS内置权威解析记录备注
